verdict.rationale: The evidence documents an MCP server that interactive AI assistants (Claude Code, ChatGPT, Codex) can use, plus bulk simulation batches run inside the product. Nothing documents a headless mode, CLI, CI integration, or API meant for automated pipelines. Driving the MCP server from a headless agent would be a user-side workaround through host tools, not a capability the product itself documents.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
